in_sanskrit.name: Balvinder
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Strong, Brave, Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Balvinder एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Balvinder is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Vindra' meaning victorious. It is a name of great power, symbolizing bravery and the ability to overcome adversity.
